'''The Crown of Maredo''' is an Inn in [[Far Madding]]. It is a modest inn, with two dozen rooms on two floors. The walls are painted yellow and the serving men wear yellow aprons. Rand stays there while waiting to kill [[Rochaid]] and [[Kisman]] and felt the cooks were very good. The innkeeper is Mistress [[Nalhera]]
